name: Synthesis of [Co(ttpp)(py)2](OTf) (500 mg scale-up)
plain_text_description:
Reference: AD-R13; 5x scale
Analysis
1H NMR: [Co(ttpp)(py)₂](OTf) (86% purity), hexane (0.47 eq, ca. 1.9% w/w)
ICP-OES: 
4% H2O (AD-R17)
8% Co(II)

Procedure
RT 21.1  °C RH   52%
Stock solution preparation
5 mL vial
Put into the glovebox (H₂O < 1 ppm)
Weigh in AgOTf → 128.72 mg
Take it out of the glovebox. 
Add 3000 µL of toluene → colorless solution.

Reaction
50 mL flask
Add Co(ttpp)
Add pyridine
Add toluene 26 mL
Sonicate for 3 min → Dark red solution 
Cover with aluminum foil
Start stirring at 400 rpm
Add  1500 µL of AgOTf/toluene dropwise w/ mechanical pipette (750 x 2)
Continue stirring for 1 h → Dark green mixture
-> 50 μL + CDCl₃ 450 μL -> 1H NMR M1 (U1.834; SW 19, NS 16) (use mechanical pipette)
plain_text_observation:
Ag scavenging
Remove volatiles with a rotovap (40 °C) for 1 h.
Dry under vacuum 1h
Add DCM 25 mL
Swirl and sonicate → Dark green mixture
Add ISOLUTE Si-Thiol
Stir at 500 rpm for 2 h
20 mL plastic syringe, cotton plug, syringe filter (⌀ 25 mm, 0.45 µm, PTFE), syringe filter (0.2 µm, ⌀ 15 mm, PTFE), 250 mL RBF [difficult to press]. Better to use a frit. or a filter paper.
Filter the mixture → Dark green filtrate collected
Transfer and rinse with DCM 50 mL → pale green filtrate at the end.
Evaporate the whole solvent. 

Reprecipitation
Add 50 mL of DCM.
Add n-hexane (300 mL).
Swirl and sonicate
Refrigerate at 0 °C for o/n
  12.05.2026 RT 22.9°C RH  31%
Frit (por. 4)
Filter the mixture →  light yellow filtrate
Transfer and rinse with 2 x (DCM 15 mL + n-hexane 100 mL)
Rinse w/ hexane 4 x 20 mL
Dry w/ suction for 10 min
Dry under vacuum o/n
